text:
Olivia K: hey team — quick question about timing. my partner's due date is flexible and we may need to travel internationally at short notice. what's the recommended cadence for filing paperwork, and how do we avoid payroll/top-up gaps if dates move?
Maya (People Ops): congrats! best practice: submit a parental_leave_request as soon as you have a window (even if tentative). that reserves your spot for benefits and lets payroll flag the account. you can update dates later.
Olivia K: if we get a 48h change, will payroll still apply the top-up without a retro?
Ben (Payroll): short answer: usually yes if change falls before our payroll cutoff (Fri 3pm PT). for <48h changes we can still handle it but might run a small retro adjustment. email payroll@redwood.com right after any change and cc your manager to speed things up.
Rhea (Benefits): add: mark the form field "flex_start: true" for uncertain windows. benefits will pre-authorize the top-up period. we'll still need final supporting docs (birth certificate, placement docs, passport pages) within 30 days of the start date.
Chris (Manager): ops side: please create a 1-page "critical tasks" doc and nominate two coverage owners. I'll cover weekly demos and oncall for the first 2 weeks. schedule a 20m handoff before departure.
Olivia K: is there guidance for travel reimbursements and whether they're taxable? we'll likely have flights + legal fees.
Rhea (Benefits): travel for adoptive/parental placement: eligible for reimbursement under the family travel policy. cap: $2,500 for domestic, $4,000 for international (per event). tax treatment depends on jurisdiction; we'll flag the claim for tax review. submit via expenses with code FAMILY_TRAVEL.
Maya (People Ops): timeline checklist link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/parental-checklist (upload portal + sample runbook). quick checklist snippet:
```
parental_leave_request
- name:
- leave_type: adoption/birth/surrogacy
- tentative_start_date:
- flex_start: yes/no
- estimated_duration:
- coverage_contacts (2):
- travel_reimbursement_needed: yes/no
- supporting_docs_pending: yes/no
```
Ben (Payroll): also note payroll code: PARENT_TOPUP. if you request partial remote work during leave, indicate % schedule in the form so payroll calculates top-up pro-rata.
Olivia K: for international cases, do we need notarized docs up front?
Rhea (Benefits): sometimes. embassy or consulate copies and notarized parentage documents speed up downstream processes. benefits will tell you exactly what's needed after you submit the request.
hr-bot: Ticket created: PARENT-1789901234. A People Ops specialist will reach out within 1 business day to set up a benefits + payroll call.
Olivia K: thanks everyone — i'll file the tentative form now and share the runbook draft for coverage. will ping here after I hear from the rep. :pray:
